Field.Name: BeginString

Field.Description: Must be third field in message

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by CFE for messages sent to CFE (Target Comp IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by CFE for messages sent to CFE. (Target Sub IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: CFE=messages sent to CFE (Sender Comp IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination: TEST=messages sent to CFE test system PROD=messages sent to CFE production system (Sender Sub IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for session

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: N=(Default) Y=Indicates a message resend and should be used during FIX Replay. All inbound orders with a value of ‘Y’ will be rejected by Cboe.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time that message was sent

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with Poss Dup Flag=‘Y’, indicates time that message was first sent

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Used to specify clearing information on messages to CFE. Must be an allowed Executing Firm ID (EFID). Sent to OCC in Exec Broker field.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. 4 Characters alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in Deliver To Sub ID. Available via Drop feeds

Field.Name: DeliverToCompId
Field.Description: Identifies end-client on messages from CFE. Used to specify clearing information

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns On Behalf Of Sub IDoptionally sent by client

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. Always unencrypted, always last field in message.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: N=Default. Indicates a new order. Y=Indicates an application level resend and is NOT supported. For reasons of economy, CFE does not track (in primary storage) the Cl Ord IDvalues of orders that are no longer live. For reasons of performance, CFE does not access secondary storage to enforce unique Cl Ord IDvalues against orders that are no longer live. Without full duplicate Cl Ord IDvalue enforcement, it is not possible to safely implement the full behavior specified in the FIX 4.2 Protocol for Poss Resend=Y. To remain economical, fast, and safe, all New Order Single messages with Poss Resend=Ywill simply be ignored.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: This field will be reflected back on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 32-126). The first 10 characters are sent to the OCC in the Account # field. The entire 16 character string will appear in the Optional CM Data field. Available via FIX DROP on an opt-in basis at the port level.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. A leading tilde (~) cannot be sent on any Cl Ord Idand will result in a reject. These are reserved for internal use by CFE and could be received as a result of a system-generated Cl Ord Id. If the Cl Ord Idmatches a live order it will be rejected as duplicate (unless Poss Resend=Y, see above). Sent to the OCC in the Order ID field. Note: CFE only enforces the uniqueness of Cl Ord IDvalues among currently live orders, which includes long-lived GTC and GTD orders. However it is strongly recommended to keep Cl Ord ID values unique.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of security. FUT=Simple instrument(Futures only) OPT=Simple instrument(Options only) MLEG=Multi-leg/Spread instrument(Futures only) MLO=Multi-leg/Spread instrument(Options only) Order rejected if instrument type (Simple vs. Multi-leg) of specified symbol doesn’t match Security Type(167).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Futures Product or CFE format symbol (case sensitive). (Futures only), if Maturity Month(200) ANDMaturity Day(205) are both provided, then the Symbol(55) is a Futures Product identifier (e.g., ‘VX’, ‘VXT’, ‘VU’, etc.). Otherwise,Symbol(55) is the 6 character mapped Symbol ID.

Field.Name: MaturityMonth
Field.Description: Used when specifying the Symbol(55) by Futures Product and Expiration Date rather than Symbol ID. When Maturity Monthis specified,Maturity Day(205) is required and Symbolmust refer to valid Futures Product identifier.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Used when specifying the Symbol(55) by Futures Product and Expiration Date rather than Symbol ID. When Maturity Dayis specified,Maturity Month(200) is required and Symbolmust refer to valid Futures Product identifier.

Field.Name: SecurityDesc(Options only)
Field.Description: Used for to identify an instrument by the security description (e.g. "UX1A/K4 C2000"). If this tag is provided,Symbol(55) should be blank or not provided.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1=Buy 2=Sell

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts for order, 1 to 999,999

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1=Market 2=Limit 4=Stop Limit(Futures only) Market implies Time In Forceof IOC. Stop Limit orders must have a Time In Forceof DAY (0), GTC (1), or GTD (6). Market orders are not allowed for complex Options on Futures and will be rejected.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit Price. Required for limit orders. If populated for a market order (Ord Type=1), the order will be accepted and behave like a market order (i.e.Pricewill be ignored). Orders will be rejected if Pricedoes not fall on the applicable minimum trading increment. For all contracts other than TAS, simple orders will be rejected if Priceis less than or equal to zero, or greater than or equal to 100,000. For TAS, simple orders will be rejected if Priceis outside the price limits presented in the contract specification. Spread orders will be rejected if Priceis outside the price limits implied by the spread instrument definition and constituent instrument min and max prices.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: The trigger price for Stop Limit orders. Required if Ord Type(40) = 4.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: The capacity for the order. C=Customer F=Firm The Order Capacityrefers to the OCC account type.Cdenotes an account that clears in the Customer range at OCC.Fdenotes an account that clears in the Clearing Firm range at OCC.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0=DAY (Default) (Expires at end of market day.)

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for Time In Force(59) =6(GTD) orders, specifies the date- time (in GMT) that the order expires. Values may be specified at a millisecond level.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill quantity for IOC orders. Ignored for other Simple instrument orders. Not supported for Spread or Options instruments. Spread or Options instrument orders with Min Qtyspecified will be rejected.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Indicates status of client position. O=Open C=Close N=None (same as not present)

Field.Name: RiskReset
Field.Description: Values may be combined S=Product-level risk/lockout reset(Futures only) F=Firm-level risk/lockout reset(Futures only) C=Custom Group IDlockout reset(Futures only) R=Product-level risk/lockout reset(Options only) I=Firm-level risk/lockout reset(Options only) D=Custom Group IDlockout reset(Options only) Resets by Custom Group IDrequire FIX Tag (7699) to be populated. Values may be combined together to allow for resets of multiple risk trips or self-imposed lockouts in a single message. For example,FS,SC,FC, and SFCare all acceptable values. The characters may be combined in any order. For example, to "reset all futures", set this field to SFC, which is the equivalent to CFS. To "reset all options", set this field to RID, which is equivalent to DIR. To "reset all futures and options" set the field to SFCRID, which is equivalent to DIRCFS. For more information, see the CFE Risk Management Specification.

Field.Name: CMTANumber
Field.Description: CMTA Number of the firm that will clear the trade. Must be supplied for CMTA orders and left unspecified for non- CMTA orders. Sent to the OCC in the CMTA CM# field.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: This field can be blank or filled out with an optional four character string. This field is recorded and returned in Execution Reports. This field is not sent to the OCC. Available via FIX Drop.

Field.Name: CustomGroupID
Field.Description: Optional TPH-specified ID for the order. Cancellation by Custom Group IDavailable using Purge Port only. Integer 1-65535

Field.Name: CTICode
Field.Description: 1=CTI 1: Transactions initiated and executed by an individual TPH for the TPH’s own account, for an account the TPH controls, or for the account in which the TPH has an ownership or financial interest. 2=CTI 2: Transactions executed for the proprietary account of a clearing TPH or non-clearing TPH. 3=CTI 3: Transactions where an individual TPH or authorized trader executes for the personal account of another individual TPH, for an account the other individual TPH controls or for an account in which the other individual TPH has an ownership or financial interest. 4=CTI 4: Any transaction not meeting the definition of CTI 1, 2 or 3. (These should be non-TPH customer transactions).

Field.Description: 0=New 1=Cancel 2=Correct 3=Status 2(Correct) is used for post-Settlement Execution Reports that update Trade At Settlement (TAS) trades with settlement offset prices and symbol changes as appropriate. 3(Status) is used for Carried Order Restatements if associated port attribute is set.

If Secondary Exec IDis present and is the same as the Exec ID(17) the fill represents a Spread execution for which associated Simple instrument fills will follow. Simple instrument fills associated with a Spread execution will contain a Secondary Exec IDmatching the Exec IDof the associated Spread execution.
